Adverbials of purpose with to / in order: Adverbials of purpose express purpose: to/in order to + base verb, so that + clause.本课为专项练习练习,核心:to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。

to + base verb is the most common|in order to emphasizes purpose|so as to / in order to can be placed at the start|so that + subject + can/may + base verb|in order not to / so as not to express a negative purpose
I got up early to catch the first bus.
column3: 我早起是为了赶上头班车。

Adverbials of purpose with to / in order: I got up early catch the first bus.|I got up early for catch the first bus.|I got up early to catch the first bus.|I got up early to catching the first bus.
column4: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:I got up early to catch the first bus.
